record_body:
Overview
- Inbound lead via website form: explicitly requested "AWS Marketplace SKUs + pricing" and asked whether they can route all spend through marketplace for FY26 committed spend.
- Product interest spans Hosted API now (pilot) + path to Dedicated capacity; Private/VPC likely required for production due to customer data handling.

Inbound message (verbatim-ish)
- "Can you send a list of AWS Marketplace SKUs and pricing? We need something procurement can attach to our intake. Also need to know if there’s a Private/VPC option via marketplace or if that’s direct contract only. Timeline is end of March."

Key stakeholders (as shared by lead)
- Director of Platform Engineering (primary champion; owns LLM platform initiative)
- Procurement manager (needs marketplace listing/SKUs to open PO workflow)
- Security/GRC reviewer (asks for SOC 2, encryption/KMS, audit logging, retention policy)
- Finance/FinOps (wants predictable unit costs; concerned about marketplace fees vs direct)

What they’re trying to do
- Customer support agent + internal ops assistant. Mix of chat + summarization; doc search/embeddings likely next.
- Wants to start with Hosted API in 1 region, then shift to Dedicated capacity if usage ramps.
- Mentioned they already have baseline on Bedrock for a couple teams; evaluating Redwood primarily for performance/cost transparency + unified ops across hosted/dedicated/private.

Requirements (early)
- Deployment: prefers VPC/private networking for production. OK with Hosted API for pilot if security posture is clear.
- Security: SOC 2 report availability (under NDA), encryption in transit + at rest, KMS language, audit logs, SSO/SAML. Asked specifically about retention controls and how to request deletion.
- Residency: asked whether they can keep inference traffic in US-only; possible future EU requirement (not immediate).
- Procurement: must buy through AWS Marketplace if possible (committed spend drawdown). Asked if GCP Marketplace is also available but primary is AWS.

Marketplace SKU/pricing questions
- Asked for:
  - Clear SKU names aligned with Redwood product packaging (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + any compliance or retention add-ons.
  - How usage is metered (tokens vs capacity) and what shows up on invoice line items.
  - Upgrade/downgrade mechanics (e.g., start Hosted, later move to Dedicated; can they change via marketplace without re-procurement?).
  - Any minimums / commit ranges for Dedicated/Private via marketplace.

Timeline / urgency
- Procurement intake due by ~2026-03-10 (to close by end of March). Champion wants security review to start immediately after receiving SKU/pricing + security FAQ.

Activity timeline
- 2026-02-05: Inbound form submission requesting AWS Marketplace SKUs + pricing; noted Q1 close target.
- 2026-02-06: Triage by Jordan Blake; assigned Markus Klein (SE) for marketplace procurement walkthrough.
- 2026-02-10: Sent initial response acknowledging upcoming marketplace refresh and offered interim SKU mapping summary; asked which marketplace account + preferred region.
- 2026-02-21: Short intro call scheduled; champion reiterated they need a procurement-friendly SKU table and "no surprises" on invoice descriptions.

Internal notes / guidance
- Keep messaging consistent with marketplace refresh packaging: do not over-promise Private availability via marketplace until final SKU submission is confirmed.
- Provide the buyer-facing marketplace security FAQ + a short statement on shared responsibility + audit log availability.
- If they need Dedicated/Private terms not supported by marketplace (custom SLA, special data residency), prep fallback path to direct contract while still allowing some spend via marketplace if feasible.

Next steps
- Markus Klein to send:
  - Draft marketplace SKU mapping table (Hosted/Dedicated/Private + add-ons) + what each includes.
  - Buyer-facing FAQ link for "Buying through Marketplace".
  - Security FAQ tailored for marketplace review (SOC2 handling under NDA, encryption/KMS wording, audit logging, retention).
- Confirm whether they require AWS Marketplace only or can use GCP Marketplace as alternate.
- Schedule follow-up with Security reviewer if they request evidence packet / NDA.

Risks
- If procurement requires final published AWS Marketplace SKUs (not draft), timeline may slip depending on marketplace listing review lead times.
- Discount expectations: they asked for "enterprise commit pricing" through marketplace; may need to set expectations around discounting constraints vs direct contracting.
